question: Should we raise the Pro plan price from $149/mo to $199/mo?
chosen_strategy: Increase Pro price to $199 with 3-month grandfathering for existing cohort

error_analysis.lesson_learned: Elasticity was under-estimated: 8% of grandfathered cohort churned at renewal.

question: Should we hire 2 tier-2 support engineers to reduce enterprise ticket backlog?
chosen_strategy: Hire 2 senior support specialists and implement Zendesk priority routing

error_analysis.lesson_learned: New hires required 7 weeks ramp time instead of assumed 3 weeks.

question: Should we expand Google Ads acquisition budget by 30%?
chosen_strategy: Scale Google Search PPC budget targeting high-intent ticketing keywords

error_analysis.lesson_learned: Bidding wars on primary keywords raised marginal CPC by 22%.

question: Should we offer a 20% annual billing discount for Starter and Pro plans?
chosen_strategy: Introduce 20% discount on upfront annual commit with in-app banner prompt

error_analysis.lesson_learned: Customers responded strongly to cash savings; upfront cash exceeded forecast.
